records.title: First part: reduced provisioning strength and no further provisions
records.header_literal: D) UKS v ZÖN (10.11 p.m., November 25th); 1849 2 TLE; 1 TL RICHI-166
records.readable_german: Infolge verringerter Verpflegungsstaerke fuer JJ. Armee keine Verpflegung mehr erforderlich.
records.meaning: The message states that reduced provisioning strength makes further provisions unnecessary for the army designated by the literal JJ label. It does not identify that army by converting J to a decimal digit.
notes: All 166 observed coordinates are present, including the final printed VGGXA F omitted by the earlier 160-coordinate OCR block. Restoring those visible coordinates is a transcription correction, not a hypothetical lost-prefix or missing-slot fill.
The word proposals VERPFLEGNNG → VERPFLEGUNG, FEHR → MEHR and ERFOGDERLICH → ERFORDERLICH have explicit observed-coordinate costs. All raw garbles remain displayed.
JJ is retained literally. The edition supplies no army identity, headcount, or numerical key reassignment.

The printed continued marker, identical UKS/ZÖN routing, 10.11 p.m. interception, 1849 internal reference and 2 TLE count associate this first part with p220 A2. The source changes its section label from D to A across the page break.

records.title: Second part: stop further provisions and notify Dresden
records.header_literal: A) UKS v ZÖN (10.11 p.m., November 25th); 1849 2 TLE; 2 TL RICHI-244
records.readable_german: Bitte Nachschub an Verpflegung sofort ganz einstellen. Gleiches Telegramm geht an Generalintendant und Proviantdepot Dresden. VIERA. U203.
records.meaning: The continuation requests an immediate, complete halt to further provisions and states that the same telegram goes to the Generalintendant and the provisions depot at Dresden. It records a request and notification, without proving that deliveries actually stopped. The closing labels VIERA and U203 remain unexpanded.
notes: The complete native 244-coordinate body matches its header. Two earlier OCR blocks split this one physical source part; neither block alone gives its full geometry.
SOFOR3 → SOFORT and GENENALINTENDANT → GENERALINTENDANT are separately priced ordinary-word proposals, with no global reinterpretation of the 3 label.
VIERA and U203 remain literal closing fields. They are not silently converted to an office, a personal name, a number or an expanded date.

The source explicitly marks this as part 2 and repeats the p219 D header. Its association with that first part is supported by printed metadata as well as the continued marker, not solely by similar meaning.

records.title: Separate evening report with unresolved unit and place labels
records.header_literal: B) UKS v ZÖN (09.54 p.m., November 25th); HATTE MR 20[4-like]7; RICHI-220
records.readable_german: Abendmeldung 13. JJ22 ALPE. K. 16. 1 ZUIGE. Es haben mit Anfaengen erreicht: 1J0ID, TISHAFOELDVAR. PRD, NAGQMAGOCS81J8. KONDOROS.
records.meaning: The recoverable clause in this separate evening report states that leading elements had reached the following listed entries. The unit, time-like and place labels are preserved literally; this edition does not identify the units or normalize the garbled place spellings.
notes: All 220 observed coordinates remain in their native order. The sole primary word proposal HABE7 → HABEN is priced as an observed-coordinate change, not as a free reading of a numeral.

13, JJ22ALPE, K, 16, 1ZUIGE, 1J0ID, TISHAFOELDVAR, PRD, NAGQMAGOCS81J8 and KONDOROS keep their exact labels. Word spacing in the opening is editorial and does not establish its syntax or reference values.
No unit number or geographical correction is supplied. In particular, TISHAFOELDVAR and NAGQMAGOCS are not silently respelled from familiar place names.
The HATTE MR heading contains a 4-like glyph rendered as [4-like] in the metadata. This is a header transcription qualification and does not add a source-ciphertext erasure or a decoded position.
B has its own source label and reception time. It is not counted as a third part of the two-part provisioning message above.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.
